question: Which of the following reactions will be possible?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 1:** CuSO₄ + Ca → CaSO₄ + Cu is possible because calcium (Ca) is more reactive than copper (Cu) and can displace it from its compound.
